ayahs.1: Those who reject the truth and block others from Allah's path—He will render their deeds void.
ayahs.2: As for those who have iman, do righteous deeds, and trust what was revealed to Muhammad—which is the truth from their Rabb—He will wipe away their sins and set their condition right.
ayahs.3: This is because those who deny follow falsehood, while the mu'min follow the truth from their Rabb. This is how Allah makes clear to people what they truly are.
ayahs.4: When you meet those who reject the truth in battle, strike until they are subdued, then bind them firmly. Later, release them by grace or by ransom until the war ends. Had Allah willed, He could have punished them Himself—but He tests some of you through others. Those martyred in Allah's cause: He will never let their deeds go to waste.
ayahs.5: He will guide them, improve their condition,
ayahs.6: and admit them into Paradise, having made it known to them as though they had always belonged there.
ayahs.7: O you who have iman: If you stand up for Allah's cause, He will support you and make your footing firm.
ayahs.8: As for those who reject the truth—ruin awaits them, and He will render their deeds void.
ayahs.9: That is because they hate what Allah has revealed, so He has made their deeds fruitless.
ayahs.10: Have they not travelled the earth and seen what became of those before them? Allah destroyed them utterly. A similar end awaits those who persist in denial.
ayahs.11: This is because Allah is the protector of the mu'min, while those who reject the truth have no protector.
ayahs.12: Allah will admit those who have iman and do righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who deny, they enjoy this dunya and eat as cattle eat—but the Fire will be their home.
ayahs.13: How many communities stronger than yours—which drove you out—did We destroy, with no one to rescue them?
ayahs.14: Can those who stand on clear proof from their Rabb be like those whose evil deeds are made to look attractive, so they follow only their desires?
ayahs.15: The Paradise promised to people of taqwa—living with Allah-consciousness as though Allah sees you—has rivers of water that never turns foul, rivers of milk whose taste never changes, rivers of wine delightful to drink, and rivers of purified honey. There they will have every kind of fruit and forgiveness from their Rabb. Can that be like those who remain in the Fire forever, drinking boiling water that tears their insides apart?
ayahs.16: Some of them listen to you, but when they leave they say mockingly to those gifted with knowledge, 'What did he just say?' These are people whose hearts Allah has sealed, and who follow only their desires.
ayahs.17: As for those who are guided, He increases them in guidance and blesses them with taqwa.
ayahs.18: Are they waiting only for the Hour to take them by surprise? Some of its signs have already appeared. When it actually comes upon them, will remorse then help them?
ayahs.19: So know that there is no god worthy of worship except Allah. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and for the believing men and women. Allah knows how you move and where you settle.
ayahs.20: The mu'min say: If only a surah were revealed allowing defence! Yet when a precise surah is revealed in which fighting is mentioned, you see those with sickness in their hearts staring at you like someone on the edge of death. It would have been better for them
ayahs.21: to obey and speak honestly. Then when fighting was ordained, it would have been far better for them if they had been true to Allah.
ayahs.22: If you turn away, you may spread corruption across the land and sever the ties of kinship Allah commanded you to maintain.
ayahs.23: These are the ones Allah has condemned—He has made them deaf and blinded their vision.
ayahs.24: Will they not reflect on the Qur'an, or are there locks upon their hearts?
ayahs.25: Those who turn back to denial after guidance has become clear to them—Satan has enticed them and filled them with false hopes.
ayahs.26: That is because they said privately to those who hate what Allah revealed: We will obey you in some matters. Allah knows what they conceal.
ayahs.27: How terrible will it be when the angels take their souls at death, striking their faces and their backs.
ayahs.28: This is because they follow what displeases Allah and hate what pleases Him, so He has rendered their deeds void.
ayahs.29: Or do those with sickness in their hearts think Allah will not expose their hidden malice?
ayahs.30: Had We willed, We could have shown them clearly to you, and you would have known them by their marks. But you will know them by the tone of their speech. Allah knows what you do.
ayahs.31: We will certainly test you until We make evident those among you who strive in jihad—struggle in Allah's cause—and those who remain steadfast, and until We see how you conduct yourselves.
ayahs.32: Those who reject the truth, block Allah's path, and defy the Messenger after guidance has become clear—they cannot harm Allah in the least, but He will render their deeds void.
ayahs.33: O you who have iman: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not let your deeds be wasted.
ayahs.34: Those who reject the truth, block Allah's path, and die in denial—Allah will never forgive them.
ayahs.35: So do not weaken or call for peace while you have the upper hand. Allah is with you, and He will never let your deeds go to waste.
ayahs.36: This dunya is only play and distraction. But if you have iman and taqwa, He will give you your full reward and will not demand all your wealth.
ayahs.37: If He demanded it and pressed you, you would withhold and your resentment would be exposed.
ayahs.38: You are being called to spend in Allah's cause, yet some of you hold back. Whoever withholds only harms himself. Allah is Self-Sufficient; you are the ones in need. If you turn away, He will replace you with another people—and they will not be like you.
